verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is a payments platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents an MCP server. The only agent-adjacent signal is an llms.txt file, which is a documentation aid and not a way to connect an agent via MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
